status: First bounded source review complete; optimization opportunities are not measured wins

scope.priority: Single-machine inference speed first; GPU memory second

version_limits: Local checkout versions only, not a claim of latest upstream.
TensorRT-LLM index has staged deletions/untracked source; all cited files were checked against its HEAD with line-ending normalization. Other reviewed repositories were clean.
Research llama.cpp HEAD is distinct from the retained D4 benchmark peer commit; source research is not a rerun of those engines.
ds4 is antirez/community, not the official DeepSeek runtime. DeepInfer SM100/Ascend and multi-GPU throughput are not RTX4070 evidence.

actions.work: Bounded cold tactic comparison for one actual hot BF16 direct-Lt projection
actions.gap: Current provider asks for one heuristic and retains that algorithm. Actual current Qwen T1 routes103 of187 MatMuls to direct Lt, including down/head; T128 routes187 of187. Counts are not a time share.
actions.next: Start with one traced head or down geometry and a small number of valid Lt algorithms in the original prepared owner. Preserve source bytes, typed rounding/accumulation and workspace limits. No hot search or general autotuning service.
actions.closure: Compare actual projection and complete host-token session. Adopt only with correct outputs and measured benefit; otherwise retain original algorithm and close this finite experiment.

actions.work: Fuse private normalization or activation into the existing quantization prologue
actions.gap: Hyle already shares quantization across compatible linears; the reviewed matching does not include the preceding norm/activation. Preserve the original BF16/F16 round even when the intermediate stays in registers.
actions.next: Choose one actually used FP8 role with matching group/scale/order/math and private intermediate; retain ordinary decomposition for escaped outputs. MXFP8/Blackwell and NVFP4 policies are not interchangeable with existing contracts.
actions.closure: Reference the unfused rounding/quantization and compare launches, traffic and full role performance. Do not claim current BF16 decode improvement from an unused FP8 path.

actions.work: Tile and pipeline one contract-compatible packed4bit linear directly into MMA
actions.gap: Hyle already reads compressed weights without a whole expanded bank. The reviewed packed_rows path uses warp F32 FMA; compatible native tiled MMA is a compute/layout opportunity, not missing format support.
actions.next: Use a supported4bit source layout/scale/cast contract; cold immutable repack if required, separate tiny-M and prefill schedules. MLX5/6bit, mixed promoted-F32 and quantized activation are separate contracts.
actions.closure: Measure a real admitted role and subsequent same-quantization consumer; retain the original math path where incompatible. No whole-bank expansion or silent low-precision reduction.

actions.work: Finish original-owner cold resources and consider mutually exclusive shape workspace sharing only where legal
source: DeepInfer and vLLM static graph pools
actions.gap: Finite children, captures, shared FP8 prologue, reserved workspace and leases already exist. Current two native-owner reductions are tested, with no throughput gain established.
actions.next: Inspect only actual first-use allocations or duplicate mutually exclusive workspace. Keep escaped old outputs, StateVersion and independent parity-slot bindings alive. Shared pointer keys/weak outputs cannot replace those proofs.
actions.closure: Report first-call/full-call and sampled memory separately. Do not start a second cache/executor or delay actual first execution outside timing.

actions.work: Device metadata/CPU bookkeeping overlap and bounded expert residency for a consumer that needs them
actions.gap: Hyle already has queues, Completion, file streaming and WeightSlots. Device token dependencies and useful expert residency are consumer policies, not universally missing Graph primitives.
actions.current_BF16_Qwen: Conditional; a fully resident small model gains nothing from SSD expert streaming.
actions.next: Use the actual MTP/large working-set consumer when reached. Include host-ID readback, waiting, cancellation/drain, cache bytes and token-visible completion. Preserve single-request semantics.
actions.closure: No current implementation promise or idle experimental candidate: reconsider only at that concrete consumer; no model support expansion.

already_present: Cold compiled finite graph family and explicit replay modes
Packed direct consumers for supported formats
Invocation workspace, result/state leases and native retirement
Bounded file pipeline and same-generation WeightSlots
result_standard: Every subsequent optimization comparison reports prefill, full decode, per-phase GPU-memory/peak, and a fixed multi-turn session elapsed/output throughput. Missing items stay explicitly unmeasured; no averaging of phase TPS.
